purpose: Track current external work relevant to AXIOM-MESH interoperability and identify reusable mechanisms, gaps, and non-adoption decisions. This is an evidence snapshot, not endorsement or standards status.

papers_and_standards.name: MCP 2026-07-28
axiom_take: do not depend on transport sessions for authority state

papers_and_standards.name: Bounded Agents / Agentic Principal Chain
axiom_take: scope history causally rather than trusting transport sessions
do not require APC vocabulary or runtime

papers_and_standards.name: AI Agent Authorization Integration Framework
axiom_take: do not hard-code OAuth or Rego

papers_and_standards.name: OpenA2A Agent Authorization Protocol
axiom_take: treat as adapter/interoperability input, not Mesh core dependency

papers_and_standards.name: Kindred Agent Identity Framework
axiom_take: reuse lifecycle and attenuation test ideas without importing authorization tiers as universal semantics

repositories.name: agentgateway/agentgateway
repositories.opportunity: Offer Mesh as optional policy/evidence/composition sidecar for high-consequence routes rather than competing gateway.

repositories.name: airlock-protocol/airlock
repositories.opportunity: Interop verification fixtures and delegation attenuation checks.

repositories.name: motebit/motebit
repositories.opportunity: Receipt portability, continuity, sovereign recovery, and runtime-neutral governance interoperability.

repositories.name: git-agentic/pkg-registry
repositories.opportunity: Treat package provenance as strong supply-chain evidence while keeping install authority separate.

repositories.name: DunkelCloud/ToolMesh
repositories.opportunity: Augment with causal composition, purpose/destination/budget binding, and portable evidence verification.

repositories.name: obsign/obsign
repositories.opportunity: Cross-verify evidence packs and policy provenance while preserving independent authorization semantics.

gaps_axiom_can_fill: protocol-neutral authority normalization across MCP, A2A, native APIs and future runtimes
causal composition controls that survive protocol and transport transitions
evidence disposition lanes so weak signals remain useful without authority laundering
selective sidecar adoption instead of requiring platform replacement
resource, purpose, destination, budget, expiry and policy-version binding in one bounded decision
identity continuity separated from endpoint-key currency
user-centric recovery where advisory continuity hints can assist recovery but privileged restoration still requires stronger proof
receipts that distinguish authorization decision, execution evidence and external-world truth claims
non_goals: replace MCP, A2A, OAuth, SPIFFE, DID, agent gateways or runtime frameworks
require cryptographic verification for every low-consequence advisory signal
let external standards or popularity override local policy
claim external projects have vulnerabilities merely because AXIOM carries negative fixtures
